title: no calibration effect
body: We're on FS libre+blucon+xdrip. Usually, with 2-3 calibrations a day we reach near accurate values. in the last week, though, BG checks are constantly 15-20mg/dl higher than xdrip, with as many false hypos as false non-hypers. Calibrations don't seem to change this fact. I usually pick detricase as calibration plugin, reading somewhere that this is the plugin most suitable for libre. but I tried also xdrip original classic algorithm to no avail
